versions.name: RXV2-0.9.132-update-bar
versions.notes: The firmware-update 'Installing…' screen now shows the same green progress bar as the simulator reboot screen (fills over ~30 s, snaps to full the moment the receiver is back) instead of a seconds counter, and its redundant Return-to-menu button is gone — it returns to the home screen by itself.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.131-reboot-bar
versions.notes: The 'Rebooting…' screen when starting/stopping simulator mode now shows a progress bar (fills over a few seconds, snaps to full the moment the receiver is back) instead of a seconds counter, and the now-redundant Return-to-menu button is gone — it returns to the home screen by itself.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.130-check-size
versions.notes: Fixes the update check failing ('network error') and the long pause entering simulator mode. The receiver was proxying the entire local + public manifests (~95 versions each, ~76 KB total) which choked it. Now the manifests are trimmed to the newest 12 versions, and the receiver skips any manifest that's still oversized — so the check stays small and fast. Rollback to recent versions is unaffected.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.129-no-back-btn
versions.notes: Removed the now-redundant 'Return to menu' button from the bottom of the pages — the floating 🏠 home button (top-left) does that from anywhere, no scrolling. Each page's Help (?) now reminds you the 🏠 button is the way back.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.128-btn-clearance
versions.notes: Every page now starts its content just below the floating Home/Help buttons, so the bigger buttons no longer overlap titles, cards or text at the top of any screen.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.127-bigger-btns
versions.notes: Made the floating Home (🏠) and Help (?) buttons bigger — easier to spot and tap.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.126-home-btn
versions.notes: Every page now has a fixed home button (🏠, top-left, mirroring the ? help button) that jumps straight back to the front menu — no more scrolling to the bottom to find Return to menu. Shown on all screens except the home page itself.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.125-check-retry
versions.notes: Makes the firmware check robust to a transient blip: it now retries once (after the receiver has had a moment to settle its WiFi, e.g. just after a reboot) before giving up. Fixes the spurious 'Network error talking to the receiver' on the firmware page and makes the 'Update now?' dialog appear reliably.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.124-update-prompt
versions.notes: When you open a receiver, it now checks for newer firmware straight away and, if there is some, pops an 'Update now?' dialog (installed vs available shown) instead of just a banner. Tap Update now and it downloads, flashes and reboots itself, then returns to the home screen — one tap, no firmware page needed. The banner remains as a tap-to-update fallback; Later dismisses it. (The check still defers while a transmitter link is live, so it never interrupts flying.)

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.123-fly-bind-guards
versions.notes: Two home-screen fixes. 'Fly now' now disables WiFi directly — one tap, with a friendly confirm that also shows your live link status (it used to just open a page where you had to find a second button). 'Start Bind mode' is now guarded: if the receiver is already bound/connected it warns before erasing the bind and dropping the link (so you can't do it by accident); unbound, it still binds straight away.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.122-status-led
versions.notes: Adds support for an external status LED on the D4 pad: OFF = bound but no link, ON = connected & receiving, 2 Hz flash = binding. Only active when transceiver 3 is absent (D4 is radio 3's CE on triple-radio boards, so those are unaffected — auto-detected). LED is assumed wired pad->resistor->LED->GND (active-high); tell me if yours is inverted.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.121-help-per-sim
versions.notes: The ? help on the controls & views screen now matches the simulator you opened: neXt gets its own help (its keys, why there are no Select/Up/Down buttons, and the Mac Input-Monitoring steps), RealFlight keeps its full controls-and-views help.
